addictionPotential: 长期使用会产生依赖但滥用潜力低。
toxicities: 咖啡因的人体 LD50 取决于个体敏感性，估计约为每公斤体重 150-200 毫克，相当于一般成年人约 80-100 杯咖啡。
summary: 咖啡因是一种中枢兴奋剂，也是全球使用最广泛的精神活性物质。其在大多数地区合法且不受监管，存在于许多常见商品中。安全性良好，但长期大量使用可导致生理依赖并促发某些健康问题。
effectsSummary: Increased alertness, energy, focus; reduced fatigue; mild diuretic effect; can cause jitters and anxiety at high doses.
generalRisks: Anxiety, restlessness, insomnia, heart palpitations, digestive issues. Withdrawal causes headaches and fatigue.
longtermRisks: Long-term high consumption may lead to chronic insomnia, anxiety disorders, digestive issues, and dependence.
saferUse: Avoid caffeine late in the day to prevent sleep disruption.
Do not combine with other stimulants in high doses.
